scene: Inside the rattling mail car, sorting pouches sway as city lights streak past.
beats: The parcel hums a gentle lullaby, soothing the roaring engine into a purr. The train glides smoothly into the Lost Property Depot as the heavy doors slide open.
The conductor beams, pressing a stamped voucher for one unclaimed keepsake into your palm. Brakes hiss musically, the carriage halts, and the depot doors roll wide.
The bell chimes overhead, dusting your beanie in colourful confetti. With a merry jingle, the train halts at Lost Property Depot and the doors part before you.
picture: Flat side-view interior of a wooden mail train carriage. On the left, parcels sit stacked on benches, one glowing with neon blue script. In the centre, the player stands beside a busy badger conductor in a uniform cap. On the right, windows show passing neon roofs, beneath a brass bell and cord up high.
shown: a parcel wrapped in brown paper glowing with blue neon script on the left
a badgeted badger conductor in a blue cap sorting letters at the centre
a dangling braided emergency cord with a brass bell attached up high on the right

after.label: Step off at Lost Property Depot
Stay on
after.beat: You stay put, watching depot lights fade as the conductor shares a warm cinnamon biscuit. At the terminus, you board the creaking bridge crawler, chugging up to the turning gears of Gear Bridge.
